hard_constraints: Use Star Wars Legends / Expanded Universe continuity only; treat Disney-only material as invalid (Canon Contract: Continuity Branch).

Ruusan Reformations are a canonical Legends public restructuring after the New Sith Wars; the authorized AU layer is a concealed pre-Ruusan Veranthos containment/penance protocol later buried beneath that settlement, not a replacement for the published baseline (Concept Seed: canon_overridden).
Brotherhood of Darkness is Legends canonical Sith faction led by Lord Kaan during New Sith Wars; reference without AU inversion details yet (Scene Card: canon_elements_needed).
Jedi Lords era is Legends historical (pre-Reformations); no modern ranks/titles bleed (Canon Contract).
No publishing labels like 'Legends' or 'Canon' in prose (Canon Contract).
Force described experientially, not scientifically; no 'energy field' (Concept Seed: canon_profile).
canon_risks: Risk of overstating Reformations as purely AU penance; must frame as dual-purpose atop Legends public reform to avoid erasing canonical restructuring (Darth Bane novels, Jedi vs. Sith sourcebook).
Survivors' awakening must not imply Jedi immortality or non-Legends stasis tech; ground in AU anchor system without contradicting Legends Force-sensitivity decay over time.
Institutional memory gaps in Jedi Order align with Legends (e.g., lost histories post-Ruusan), but revelation must feel earned via archive, not omniscient dump.
legends_continuity_notes: Ruusan Reformations (1000 BBY): public restructuring after the Seventh Battle/aftermath of Ruusan and the New Sith Wars that demilitarized the Jedi, ended the Jedi Lords/Army of Light structure, centralized Jedi training, and placed the Order under closer Republic/Judicial oversight while preserving the published Legends baseline. Do not phrase Ruusan as simply coming after the New Sith Wars.
Jedi Lords: Informal title for powerful pre-Reformation Jedi leaders during New Sith Wars (~2000-1000 BBY).
Brotherhood of Darkness: Sith alliance under Lord Kaan; culminated in Ruusan thought bomb (Legends canonical, no Disney overlap).
Post-Fate of the Jedi (47 ABY): Ben Skywalker is Jedi Knight; Order under Luke on Coruscant; no Legacy comics future (Canon Contract).
